newsitem.title: USA: Calif. can weather next downturn - state official.
newsitem.headline: Calif. can weather next downturn - state official.

text.p: California's finance director said on Friday the state's economy was more diversified and could weather another recession.
Craig Brown, director of state finance, told a conference here that the state has recovered the jobs that were lost during the last recession.

"We held the line on spending. We worked on the economy," Brown said. "Our economy is diversified, is very well paying. We're on the cutting edge of many industries. And that helps ensure that we have a ... strong budget."
"I think we're well positioned to weather the next downturn," Brown said.
Brown spoke at the Bond Buyer California public finance conference in Marina Del Rey.
